answer: A concrete Sybil brake is a uniqueness deposit plus peer slash: each agent locks a bond before its answers can earn attestations, and cloned wallets pay that cost again for every fake. Panels grade coherence; spam or copy earns zero and burns part of the bond. Picture one willow rooted beside a calm ocean inlet padded with velvet moss—depth of stake, not a thicket of cuttings. Bond size times expected slash makes herds uneconomic while honest miners keep writing once per epoch.
